messages:
Incident Bot: Pager triggered — high error rate on /v2/generate (P1). Trigger time 02:03 UTC. Oncall: Alice M. Bridge: https://bridge.redwood/incident/2425 :rotating_light:
Alice M: I'm on the bridge, collecting logs now. Ben/Sara can you standby for mitigation?
Ben T: looking into it. Quick grep shows a spike right after a model-routing config push at 02:01 UTC. Preparing a rollback.
Deploy Bot: Rollback initiated by Ben T — revert id d-2425-rev1.
Alice M: Traffic shifting to fallback model, latency improving (tail 800ms -> 120ms). Marking mitigation in progress.
Sara K: I'll start assembling traces and KV cache metrics. Initial hunch: shard mismatch increasing cache misses.
Maya R: Reached out to affected customers via status.redwood.ai, logging replies in the incident tracker. No reported data loss, some timed requests.
Alice M: Good. Once we close the bridge we need a post-incident plan: draft RCA by EOD tomorrow, peer review Wed, signoff Thurs. Owners: Alice (timeline), Ben (deploy root cause), Sara (perf/repro), Maya (customer impact).
Ben T: Ack. I'll attach the revert diff and deploy logs to the incident doc (https://docs.redwood/incident/2425).
Sara K: I'll add a small reproducer and perf flamegraphs. Also will check if quant/kv interaction surfaced the mismatch.
Maya R: I'll compile customer impact summary and update the external status message draft.
Alice M: Required action items: 1) add pre-deploy validation to model-routing (Ben) 2) KV shard healthcheck + alert (Eng-Infra) 3) run cross-region model failover test (SRE). I'll enter these into the action tracker and assign owners.
Ben T: Opening PR for pre-deploy check now: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234 :thumbsup:
Product Ops: Calendar invite sent for RCA signoff Thurs 11:00, invited Alice, Ben, Sara, Maya. Added legal and security as optional.
Alice M: Incident resolved at 02:27 UTC. Postmortem skeleton created: https://docs.redwood/postmortem/2425. Please add your sections by EOD tomorrow.
Incident Bot: Incident closed. Summary: rollback restored service, mitigation validated, no customer data loss.
Ben T: Thanks team. Will follow up in the doc with diffs and a tentative timeline.
Sara K: I'll put the reproducer and perf annex in the doc tonight.
Maya R: I'll capture customer responses and sample status updates.
Alice M: Thanks — aiming for final signoff after peer review. :white_check_mark:
